patterns.prevention:
• **Audit** coach engagement levels at all centres within 2 weeks—use a simple 1-5 rating from centre managers on energy, reliability, and interaction quality.

• **Replace** underperforming coaches immediately rather than waiting; identify backup coaches now and brief them on each centre's expectations before transitions occur.

• **Communicate** openly with centres about coach changes in advance—never let them discover a coach won't return from the coach themselves.

• **Schedule** monthly check-ins between state managers and centre directors to surface coaching concerns early, before cancellation becomes the only option.
